units.text: I sing of Cyllenian Hermes, the Slayer
of Argus, lord of Cyllene and Arcadia rich in
flocks, luck-bringing messenger of the deathless gods. He was born of
Maia, the daughter of Atlas, when she had mated with Zeus,—
a shy goddess she. Ever she avoided the throng of
the blessed gods and lived in a shadowy cave,
and there the Son of Cronos used to
lie with the rich-tressed nymph at dead of night, while white-armed Hera
lay bound in sweet sleep: and neither deathless god nor mortal man knew it.
And so hail to you, Son of Zeus and Maia; with you I
have begun: now I will turn to another song!Hail, Hermes, giver
of grace, guide, and giver of good things!
